# GCP to AWS Migration Guide

This guide covers migrating your workloads from Google Cloud Platform to Amazon Web Services.

## Amazon Bedrock Regional Availability

Amazon Bedrock is available in the following AWS regions: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1.
These regions provide full access to all Bedrock foundation models and features.

## Migration Steps

1. Choose your target AWS region
2. Configure your AWS credentials
3. Deploy your application
